visuals.caption: A circle with centre M: C is inside it, B is on it, and A is outside it.
Six circles M with tangent AB, each marked with the angles, lengths and equal-length ticks the book gives.
Three circles M with a line through A and B, each marked with the angles and ticks that show AB is a tangent.
Circle M with a straight line L running through its centre.
A circle with its centre N marked.
A small circle N and a bigger circle M apart on one line through their centres, with an arrow showing N sliding right.
Two separate circles N and M with radii r₂ and r₁, and the segment joining their centres.
Circles N and M touch at A on the line of centres, with a vertical line through A.
Two circles M and N overlap, crossing at A and B, with the overlap lens shaded and the line of centres NM drawn.
A small circle N sits inside a larger circle M and touches it at A, with the common tangent line through A and B on it.
A small circle sits inside a bigger one and both share the same centre, so they are concentric.
Three circles with centre M: MA is longer than, equal to, and shorter than the radius.
A small circle N lies inside a larger circle M without touching it, and their centres are different points.
Circle N (radius 6) touches circle M (radius 10) from inside at A, with the common tangent AB and triangle BMN shaded.
Circles N and M cross at A and B, with diameter CD of M, tangent CX through E, and line NM meeting AB at F.
Circles M and N cross at A and B, with MA = 10 cm, the line of centres MN meeting AB at D, and a 30° angle at M.
Right triangle ABC with the right angle at A and AD drawn perpendicular to BC at D.
Circles N (NA = 8 cm) and M (MA = 6 cm) cross at A and B, with the line of centres NM meeting the common chord AB at C.
Circle M with radius MB, and point A outside the circle joined to M.
Line L is perpendicular to line MA at A, and A lies outside circle M.
A is inside circle M, and line L through A meets the circle at C and D.
A is on circle M, and line L perpendicular to MA at A touches the circle only at A.
Line L touches circle M at A, and radius MA points straight down to it.
Diameter AB of circle M, with line L through A perpendicular to it, touching the circle at A.
Circle M with radius MX = 5 cm, XY = 12 cm, and MY cutting the circle at Z with ZY = 8 cm.
